description: Converts a NetCDF4 (.nc) file stored in S3 to a tabular DataFrame. Downloads the file, opens it with xarray, optionally subsets variables, and flattens all dimensions to rows. All-NaN rows are dropped. The input dataset is ignored — this profile operates entirely from the source_uri parameter. Typical use: import climate sensor arrays, oceanographic model output, or atmospheric reanalysis grids for downstream forecasting or anomaly detection.

source_uri.description: S3 URI of the NetCDF4 file to ingest (s3://bucket/key.nc)

variables.description: Variable names to extract (default: all variables in the dataset)

output_schema.note: Output columns depend on the NetCDF file content: dimension index columns + one column per variable
